name: interview-prep
description: Builds interview intel fast: company and named-interviewer research (site, news, filings registries, hiring signals, revenue model, annual reports, earnings calls, employer reputation), STAR-format answers, smart questions (incl. stakeholder-alignment checks), an intro, and engagement-type-aware HR-screen basics. Multi-round aware via transcript debrief, and builds the actual presentation when a round requires presenting back. Scales from a 10-minute rapid brief to a full dossier.
